before_snapshot.reference product: catalyst, nickel on aluminium oxide, hydrogenation
before_snapshot.comment: NICKEL-ON-ALUMINA CATALYST PROCESS REFERENCE, 2026-10-20. CN115010650A uses commercial shaped alumina, nickel-nitrate impregnation, drying120C10h and calcination400C3h, but omits loading and manufacture LCI. Select 20wt% Ni in a reduced dry catalyst: the explicit reduced/passivated basis in https://doi.org/10.1007/s10562-021-03884-2 is a loading analogue, not performance evidence for TAA hydrogenation. Use 80wt% non-metallurgical alumina as a support-supply proxy; its exact gamma phase, pore area and shaped carrier process remain unverified. Nickel nitrate manufacturer https://www.shepchem.com/chemistry/nickel-nitrate-solution-13/ confirms dissolution of nickel metal in nitric acid. Integrated chemistry follows the metal/acid reference in Pacific Organics2017 PFRp60 https://environmentclearance.nic.in/writereaddata/Online/TOR/12_Sep_2017_121716393XNVOK34HAnnexure-Pre-feasibilityReport%28PFR%29File.pdf : Ni+4HNO3+4H2O -> Ni(NO3)2.6H2O+2NO2; nitrate calcination produces NiO+2NO2+0.5O2+6H2O; NiO+H2 -> Ni+H2O. Net per Ni: 4HNO3+H2 -> 4NO2+0.5O2+3H2O. Nickel atoms remain in catalyst, not reaction products. The native nitric-acid input is kg PURE HNO3 in 50wt% stock, with one equal kg carrier water; add no duplicate stock water. Fully dry this water plus reaction water to generic air Water in m3 (1000kg/m3). No acid crystallization intermediate is purchased again. Hydrogen activation is supported as an operation by the ketone-hydrogenation preparation analogue https://doi.org/10.3390/molecules25040803; its detailed loading claim conflicts with its gram recipe, so that gram recipe is NOT used as a quantitative BOM. Reference activation uses one net H2/Ni; additional purges and incomplete reduction remain unmeasured. Assumed 95% retention of both solids: buy 1/0.95 gross Ni/alumina, dispose exactly the 0.05263158kg dry loss once without organic-waste combustion. Product contains 0.2kg Ni+0.8kg Al2O3/kg. Thermal50MJ/kg and auxiliary1kWh/kg are explicit engineering allowances for precursor manufacture, impregnation, drying, calcination, shaping activation, scrubbing and residue drying, not measured or derived from holding time alone. Reference water evaporation is about 5.86kg/kg catalyst; thermal duty is not allowed to silently disappear. One Nm3 N2/kg at1.25kg/Nm3 is a purge allowance with equal air release. PFRp61 explicitly sends nitrate-manufacture NO2 to a scrubber, with no measured removal efficiency or reagent budget. Include an explicit 90% caustic-capture reference for both precursor and calcination NO2; this is a selected model, not the factory specification. EPA documents alkaline NOx absorption and nitrate/nitrite waste https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/2020-09/documents/final_background_document_for_nitric_acid_section_8.8.pdf and reported 90% examples https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=9100E3DR.TXT. 2NO2+2NaOH -> NaNO2+NaNO3+H2O. Purchase one mole pure NaOH per captured mole NO2 via the 50wt% stock; add 8kg DI water/kg pure NaOH to obtain a 10wt% starting solution (stock already carries 1kg/kg). Internal recirculated scrubber water is not purchased repeatedly. Dry the net blowdown water and contain its calculated nitrate/nitrite salts with manufacturing solids in the underground-deposit proxy, not an organic incineration profile or uncharacterized discharge. Actual industrial wastewater treatment, salt oxidation and efficiency remain unverified; containment is not a measured hazard classification. No recovered acid or fertilizer credit. Only the uncaptured NO2 reaches air, expressed as kg NO2 in the native NOx flow. Calculated oxygen release (0.0573865294kg/kg catalyst) is retained in the reaction/mass ledger and this documentation, with no oxygen-product credit. It has zero CF in every selected EF3.1 category and its generic emission flow is absent from the available ecoinvent3.6 biosphere, so no unsupported oxygen biosphere row is inserted. The reaction ledger includes this uncharacterized release; do not claim that summing only the biosphere rows gives complete foreground mass closure. Engineering sensitivities cover loading, retention, campaign life and manufacturing utilities. GLO supply with mixed background geographies is a modelling reference, not the original Chinese plant. Spent catalyst treatment belongs to the consuming reaction; do not dispose the sold 1kg catalyst again in this production provider. No recovery credits, native or runtime changes. Element closure checks bookkeeping only.

The Beierlein loading analogue is reduced/passivated and deposition-precipitated for methanation, not a measured loading or workup for the patent's impregnated hydrogenation catalyst. Gamma phase, shaping, passivation, actual losses and utilities remain unverified. Spent sold catalyst belongs only to the consuming reaction, never a second time to this provider. Bookkeeping closure is not industrial completeness or rights clearance.
